cases.sentence: Явное ___ было видно в этих маленьких, добрых, серых глазах.
cases.translation: Evident compassion was visible in those small, kind, gray eyes.
cases.explain: Сострадание is the subject of «было видно» (was visible), so it stands in the nominative case.

cases.sentence: Ей так страшно было теперь оставаться одной, что, не дожидаясь ___ человека, она пошла навстречу ему.
cases.translation: She was now so afraid to remain alone that, without waiting for the man's arrival, she went to meet him.
cases.explain: The construction «не дожидаясь» (not waiting for) governs the genitive case, giving прихода (arrival).

cases.sentence: Она даже не верила своей ___ и подошла к трюмо, чтобы увидеть, причесана ли она в самом деле.
cases.translation: She did not even trust her own hand, and went to the mirror to see whether she was really combed.
cases.explain: The verb верила (believed/trusted) governs the dative case, giving руке (hand).

cases.translation: Having sent off the telegram, she went to get dressed.
cases.explain: Телеграмму is the direct object of the verb отослав (having sent), so it takes the accusative case.

cases.sentence: Пошлите Михайлу с ___ в конюшни. Поскорее.
cases.translation: Send Mikhaila with the note to the stables. Quickly.
cases.explain: The preposition с (with) governs the instrumental case, giving запиской (note).

cases.sentence: Явное сострадание было видно в этих маленьких, добрых, серых ___.
cases.translation: Evident compassion was visible in those small, kind, gray eyes.
cases.explain: The preposition в (in) denoting location governs the prepositional case, giving глазах (eyes).

reading.ru: Кончено, сказала себе Анна, стоя у окна.
reading.question: What word did Anna say to herself as she stood by the window?
reading.explain: The chapter opens with Anna saying to herself, standing at the window, "It's over" (Кончено).

reading.ru: Человек отвечал, что граф поехал в конюшне.
reading.question: Where was the count (Vronsky) said to have gone?
reading.explain: The servant answers that the count went to the stables.

reading.question: What did Anna write in her note to Vronsky?
options: "Come back home, we need to talk"
"I never want to see you again"
reading.correct: "Come back home, we need to talk"
reading.explain: Anna's note reads, in part, "Come back home, we need to talk it over."

reading.ru: Милая и робкая улыбка была первая мысль ее, когда она увидала свою пухлую румяную девочку с черными волосами вместо Сережи, которого она при запутанности своих мыслей ожидала видеть в детской.
reading.question: Who did Anna find in the nursery instead of the son she confusedly expected?
options: Her plump, rosy-cheeked daughter with dark hair
reading.correct: Her plump, rosy-cheeked daughter with dark hair
reading.explain: The text says she saw her plump, rosy-cheeked little girl with black hair, instead of Seryozha whom she had expected to see.

reading.question: How much time had passed as Anna waited for a reply?
reading.explain: The text says twelve minutes had passed.

reading.ru: «Да это я!» — вдруг поняла она, и, оглядывая себя всю, она почувствовала вдруг на себе его поцелуи и, содрогаясь, двинула плечами.
reading.question: What realization startled Anna as she looked in the mirror?
options: Recognizing her own reflection and suddenly feeling his kisses on her body
reading.correct: Recognizing her own reflection and suddenly feeling his kisses on her body
reading.explain: The text says she suddenly realized "Why, it's me!" and, looking herself over, felt his kisses on herself and shuddered.

reading.question: How did Annushka estimate the round trip to the stables?
options: It wouldn't take long at all
reading.explain: Annushka reassures Anna: "Fifteen minutes there, fifteen back."

reading.question: Where had the count and his mother gone, according to the returning messenger?
reading.explain: The messenger reports that they had left for the Nizhny Novgorod road and could not be found.

reading.question: What did Anna do after the messenger returned without finding Vronsky?
reading.explain: The text says she wrote out a telegram, asking him to come at once.

reading.ru: «Аннушка, милая, что мне делать?» — рыдая, проговорила Анна, беспомощно опускаясь на кресло.
reading.question: What did Anna ask Annushka, sobbing?
reading.explain: Anna, sobbing, asks Annushka, "My dear, what should I do?", sinking helplessly into a chair.

reading.question: What destination did Anna give to Pyotr the coachman at the end of the chapter?
reading.explain: The chapter ends with Anna telling Pyotr to drive to Znamenka, to the Oblonskys'.
